description: RESEARCH-ONLY (is_gate:false, routes_in_production:false, un-wired). Generalized CLASS of the P302 pooltogether M-02/M-03/M-07 misses: an ERC4626 wrapper's max*/limit function is NOT faithful to the action it bounds. Two sub-shapes: (i) LIMIT-vs-ACTION primitive mismatch — a max{Deposit,Mint,Withdraw,Redeem} bounds via underlying maxDeposit/maxMint/maxRedeem/convertTo* but the paired action calls a DIFFERENT underlying primitive (e.g. maxDeposit uses yieldVault.maxDeposit while the deposit path uses yieldVault.mint -> advertised max not fulfillable; OR a max-withdraw/redeem bounds via convertToAssets(maxRedeem) — a cross-basis estimate that may not match the action's redemption rounding -> over-report/revert). (ii) CAP omits accrued claimable — a deposit/mint cap is computed from a base supply but a separately-accrued mintable balance (yieldFeeBalance/accruedFees/pendingRewards) that also consumes that cap is not subtracted -> cap over-reports. Two-signal AND per sub-shape; suppress single-primitive-consistent vaults and pure-math libs. Anchors: PrizeVault maxDeposit/_depositAndMint, _maxYieldVaultWithdraw/_withdraw, maxDeposit/_twabSupplyLimit/yieldFeeBalance.

fp_controls.two_signal_required: sub-shape (i) requires a vault-dotted estimate primitive in the limit AND a mismatched/converted basis vs the paired action; sub-shape (ii) requires a supply-cap term in the limit's OWN body AND a contract-level accrued claimable AND that claimable absent from the limit's own body.
fp_controls.consistent_vault_suppression: a wrapper whose max{X} uses underlying max{X} and whose action uses the matching underlying {x} (maxDeposit->deposit, maxRedeem->redeem, ...) -> no mismatch -> silent.
fp_controls.no_underlying_suppression: a limit computed purely from the wrapper's own state (no vault-dotted estimate primitive) -> silent.
fp_controls.claimable_accounted_suppression: a cap that references/subtracts the accrued claimable -> sub-shape (ii) silent.
fp_controls.library_suppression: pure math / ERC4626 base libraries -> silent.
